name: RealDynLFV
title: A Large-Parallax Benchmark for Real-World Dynamic Light Field Video
overview: RealDynLFV is a large-parallax benchmark for real-world dynamic light field video. It comprises 45 dynamic scene sequences recorded from a 5 × 5 camera array. Camera recordings are temporally aligned in post-processing using audio signals; the cameras are not hardware-synchronized.
availability: The benchmark dataset and accompanying resources are being prepared for release. Availability updates will be provided on this project page.

validated_tasks: The benchmark has been evaluated for light field video reconstruction and coding. Detailed evaluation settings and results will be presented with the paper and accompanying resources.
potential_tasks: Light field video interpolation is a potential application. It is distinct from the reconstruction and coding tasks evaluated in the current work.
